sections.heading: Full Body Checkup In Gorakhpur — Screening Hai, Report Card Nahi
sections.lead: Naam "full body" hai, lekin ye poore sharir ki jaanch nahi hoti.
blocks: Full body checkup ek package hota hai — kuch blood aur urine ke test ek saath, ek hi sample me, ek tay daam par. Iska kaam un cheezon ko jaldi pakadna hai jo chup chaap badh rahi hoti hain: sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, liver, kidney aur vitamin ki kami. Inme se koi bhi shuruaat me kuch mehsoos nahi karati — yahi package ka poora point hai.

Aur yahi baat sabse zyada galat samjhi jaati hai. "Full body kara liya, sab theek hai" — ye vaakya khatarnak hai. Package me cancer ki screening nahi hoti, dil ki bimari ka pakka pata nahi chalta, haddi aur jodon ki jaanch nahi hoti, aur jo cheezein machine par dikhti hain — X-ray, ultrasound, ECG — wo isme aati hi nahi. Wo hamari service me bhi shaamil nahi hain.
Isliye seedha niyam: koi shikayat pehle se hai to package mat chuniye — doctor ko dikhaiye aur wahi test karaiye jo wo kahe. Package un logon ke liye hai jinhe abhi kuch nahi hai.

sections.heading: Sasta Full Body Checkup Gorakhpur — Daam Kis Baat Par Tay Hota Hai
sections.lead: Sasta aur mehnga me farak ginti ka nahi, shaamil test ka hota hai.
blocks: Is sheher me package ke vikalp bahut hain, aur daam me kaafi farak dikhta hai. Wo farak teen cheezon se aata hai: package me kaunse test hain, unme se kitne mehnge test hain, aur kya usme vitamin jaise test bhi hain. Vitamin D aur B12 apne aap me mehnge test hain — jis package me ye dono hain uska daam badhega hi, aur wo badha hua daam sach me kuch de raha hota hai.

list: Do package ka daam milaate waqt sirf number mat dekhiye — dono ki list saamne rakhiye aur upar wali saat cheezein tick kijiye. Jis package me thyroid ya vitamin nahi hai, wo sasta isliye hai kyunki usme kam hai.
Package me bachat sabse zyada hoti hai. Wahi test alag-alag karane par kharcha kai guna ho jaata hai — yahi package ka poora point hai.
Home collection ka koi alag charge nahi hai. Package ka jo daam likha hai wahi dena hota hai — na visiting charge, na travel charge.
Payment sample lene ke waqt hota hai, cash ya UPI se. Pehle se paisa dene ki zaroorat nahi.
Report par reference range aur method chhapega ya nahi — ye poochhiye. Sabse sasti report agar padhi hi na ja sake to wo sasti nahi, bekaar hai.

sections.heading: Lipid Profile Test In Gorakhpur — Poora Package Khaali Pet Isi Wajah Se Hota Hai
sections.lead: Package me sirf yahi test fasting maangta hai. Isliye slot ka poora hisaab isi par tikka hai.
blocks: Lipid Profile me cholesterol aur triglyceride ke chaar-paanch number aate hain — Total Cholesterol, LDL, HDL aur Triglycerides. Ye dil ki bimari ka sabse jaldi milne wala ishaara hai, aur wo ishaara aksar der se pakda jaata hai kyunki koi lakshan hota hi nahi.

list: Isme fasting lagti hai — 10 se 12 ghante. Poora package isi ek test ki wajah se khaali pet hota hai. HbA1c, TSH, CBC, LFT, Vitamin D aur B12 me fasting lagti hi nahi.
Triglycerides khaane par sabse zyada upar-neeche hote hain. Ek din pehle bahut tala-bhuna khaya ho to number badha hua aa sakta hai — ek din pehle aam khana khaiye, na zyada parhez, na daawat.
Ek din pehle sharaab bilkul nahi. Triglycerides is par seedha badh jaate hain aur report ka matlab bigad jaata hai.
LDL ko "kharaab" aur HDL ko "achha" kehna aasan hai lekin adhoora hai. Doctor teenon ko saath me, aur sugar tatha BP ke saath milakar dekhta hai.
Sugar ki dawa chal rahi hai to lipid saal me ek baar zaroor — ye wahi test hai jo follow-up me sabse zyada chhoota hai.

blocks: Isliye package ke liye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye: khaali pet ka waqt sabse kam rehta hai aur naashta sample ke turant baad ho jaata hai.

sections.heading: Liver Function Test (LFT) Price Gorakhpur Aur Kidney Function Test (KFT) — Package Me Ya Alag?
sections.lead: Dono package me aa jaate hain. Alag se karane ka apna waqt hai, aur wo alag hai.
blocks: LFT aur KFT do chup rehne wale ang ki jaanch hain. Liver aur kidney dono ki khaasiyat yahi hai ki wo kaafi door tak bina shikayat ke kaam karte rehte hain — jab tak lakshan dikhte hain, kaafi hissa peeche chhoot chuka hota hai. Isiliye ye dono har dhang ke package me hone chahiye.

list: LFT me kya aata hai — Bilirubin (total aur direct), SGOT/AST, SGPT/ALT, Alkaline Phosphatase, aur protein tatha albumin. Peeliya, fatty liver aur dawa ka asar — teenon yahin dikhte hain.
KFT me kya aata hai — Urea, Creatinine, Uric Acid aur electrolytes. Iske saath urine routine hona chahiye, warna aadhi tasveer hi milti hai.
LFT me aam taur par fasting nahi lagti. Package me aa raha hai to package ke niyam chalenge (yaani khaali pet, lipid ki wajah se).
KFT me bhi aam taur par fasting nahi lagti. Sample se pehle paani peete rahiye — paani ki kami me urea aur creatinine jhoothe taur par badhe hue aate hain.
Daam ke liye rate list dekhiye — LFT aur KFT dono ka rate service page par likha hai, aur package me lene par alag-alag karane se kaafi kam padta hai.

blocks: Alag se kab karaiye, ye tay karna aasan hai. Barsaat ke baad peeliya ke maamle is ilaake me badhte hain — aankhon ya peshab ka rang peela dikhe, bhookh mar jaaye, ya lagatar kamzori rahe to LFT alag se, doctor ke kehne par. Aur sugar ya BP ki dawa chal rahi ho to KFT saal me ek baar, urine microalbumin ke saath — microalbumin wahi test hai jo sabse pehle ishaara deta hai ki kidney par asar shuru ho raha hai, us waqt jab creatinine ab bhi normal dikhta hai. Yahi test package me aksar nahi hota aur sabse zyada chhoota hai.

Ek baat test se pehle bata dene wali: jo dawa chal rahi hai — dard ki goli, antibiotic, ayurvedic ya bina label wale nuskhe, aur sharaab — ye sab LFT aur KFT dono ke number par asar daal sakte hain. Booking ke waqt bata dijiye. In dono par vistaar se

sections.heading: Senior Citizen Health Package Gorakhpur — 55 Ke Upar Kya Jodna Chahiye
sections.lead: Is umar me package ka kaam badal jaata hai — screening se follow-up ki taraf.
blocks: 55 ke upar package chunne ka tareeka alag hai. Is umar me sirf "kuch chhupa hua hai kya" nahi dekha jaata; ye bhi dekha jaata hai ki jo pehle se chal raha hai wo kis disha me ja raha hai. Isliye senior citizen package me kuch cheezein zaroori ho jaati hain jo kam umar me optional thi.

list: HbA1c — sirf fasting sugar kaafi nahi. Is umar me sugar ka teen mahine ka ausat zyada kaam ka hota hai.
KFT ke saath urine routine — kidney par asar sabse chup chaap shuru hota hai, aur umar ke saath ye risk badhta hai.
Lipid Profile — dil ke liye. Ye is umar me har saal hona chahiye, chahe pichhli baar normal aaya ho.
Thyroid — bujurgon me thyroid ke lakshan aksar "umar ka asar" maan liye jaate hain: thakan, wazan, thand, sust rehna.
Vitamin D — haddi aur girne ke khatre se seedha juda hua. Ghar ke andar rehne wale bujurgon me kami aam hai.
Vitamin B12 — jhunjhuni, sunnpan aur yaadasht ki shikayat me ise dekha jaata hai.

blocks: Do cheezein jo package me nahi aatin aur is umar me zaroori hain: aankh ki jaanch aur pair ki jaanch (khaas kar sugar wale mareezon me). Ye doctor ke paas hoti hain, lab me nahi — inhe lab test se mat badaliye. Isi tarah BP ki naapti ghar par hoti rehni chahiye; wo package ka hissa nahi hai.

Bujurgon ke liye ghar par sample lene ka faayda sabse zyada hai — nikalna hi sabse mushkil hissa hota hai. Booking me mareez ki haalat likh dijiye: bistar par hain, nas patli hai, ya khoon patla karne wali dawa chal rahi hai.

sections.lead: Pehla package ek photo hai. Doosra package se disha milti hai, aur disha hi kaam ki cheez hai.
blocks: Package ki report lambi hoti hai aur usme kuch na kuch laal zaroor dikhta hai. Isliye padhne ka ek kram hona chahiye — aur uska sabse zaroori hissa pichhle saal ki report hai.

list: Pehle header — naam, umar, gender. Reference range inhi par badalti hai.
Phir wo paanch cheezein jo package ka asli kaam hain: sugar, lipid, liver, kidney aur CBC.
Har number ke bagal me us lab ki apni reference range dekhiye. Doosri lab ki range se mat milaiye.
Ab pichhle saal ki report kholiye aur wahi paanch cheezein milaiye. Number normal range me hai lekin har saal upar badh raha hai — ye baat ek saal ki report kabhi nahi bata sakti.
Halka sa upar-neeche hona apne aap me bimari nahi hai. Doctor pattern dekhta hai, ek number nahi.
Vitamin ki kami nikli ho to apne mann se high-dose goli shuru mat kijiye — khuraak kami ki gehrai par tay hoti hai.

blocks: Isi wajah se do baatein maayne rakhti hain. Pehli — har baar lagbhag usi mahine me karaiye, taaki tulna seedhi rahe. faqs.question: Gorakhpur me full body checkup me kya-kya aata hai?
faqs.answer: Kam se kam paanch cheezein honi chahiye: CBC, blood sugar, lipid profile, liver function test (LFT), aur kidney function test (KFT) ke saath urine routine. Bade package me thyroid, HbA1c aur Vitamin D tatha B12 bhi jud jaate hain. Kaunse package me kya-kya hai uski poori list service page par hai — parameter ki ginti se zyada yahi list dekhni chahiye.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur wajah aksar sirf ek test hoti hai — lipid profile, jisme 10 se 12 ghante fasting lagti hai (fasting sugar bhi ho to wo bhi). HbA1c, TSH, CBC, LFT, Vitamin D aur B12 me fasting lagti hi nahi. Isliye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye, raat ka khana 9 baje tak kar lijiye, beech me sirf saada paani, aur naashta taiyaar rakhiye.

faqs.question: LFT aur KFT package me aate hain ya alag se karane padte hain?
faqs.answer: Dhang ke har package me dono aate hain, aur package me lene par alag-alag karane se kaafi kam padta hai. Alag se tab karaiye jab koi shikayat ho — jaise peeliya ke lakshan me LFT — ya sugar aur BP ki dawa chal rahi ho, jahan KFT saal me ek baar urine microalbumin ke saath hona chahiye. Microalbumin package me aksar nahi hota aur sabse zyada chhoota hai.

faqs.question: Senior citizen package me aisa kya hota hai jo normal package me nahi?
faqs.answer: 55 ke upar package ka kaam screening se follow-up ki taraf badal jaata hai. Isliye HbA1c, KFT ke saath urine routine, lipid, thyroid aur Vitamin D — ye sab zaroori ho jaate hain, jo kam umar me optional the. Do cheezein package me nahi aatin aur is umar me zaroori hain: aankh ki jaanch aur pair ki jaanch. Wo doctor ke paas hoti hain, lab me nahi.

faqs.question: Zyada parameter wala package hamesha behtar hota hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Ginti apne aap me kuch nahi batati — ek package 80 parameter de sakta hai jisme thyroid ho hi na, aur wo 45 parameter wale se kamzor hoga. Do package milaate waqt dono ki list saamne rakhiye aur dekhiye ki CBC, sugar, lipid, LFT, KFT, thyroid aur vitamin me se kya-kya hai. Jo chhoot gaya, uska pata agle saal chalta hai.

faqs.question: OPD dikhani hai — package pehle karwa lein ya doctor ko pehle dikhayein?
faqs.answer: Koi nayi shikayat hai to doctor pehle — package aapki shikayat ka jawab nahi deta aur wo kuch aur test likh sakta hai. Sirf saalana checkup hai to package seedhe karwa lijiye, doctor ki parchi ki zaroorat nahi. Follow-up hai to jo test pichhli baar hue the wahi dohraiye, OPD se ek din pehle — report agli subah PDF me haath me hogi.

faqs.question: Package saal me kitni baar karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Umar 30 se kam aur koi shikayat nahi — do saal me ek baar kaafi hai. 30 ke upar saal me ek baar, aur har baar lagbhag usi mahine me, taaki do saal ki report seedhi tuli ja sakein. Ek-do mahine me dobara karana bekaar hai; number itni jaldi badalte nahi. Sugar, BP ya thyroid ki dawa chal rahi ho to follow-up alag chalta hai — use package se mat badaliye.

faqs.question: Ghar ke chaar log ek saath full body checkup kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur yahi sabse aasan tareeka hai. Sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai. Har vyakti ka naam, umar aur package alag likhwaiye. Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi. Report har vyakti ki alag PDF me aati hai.
